== Summary ==
Identified: [[Josh Kohman]]. Caption "2002 Bespin Regional Champion"; the champion was Josh Kohman (director's report; wiki event page).

== Description ==

2002 Bespin Regional champion [[Josh Kohman]] outside Coach's Corner. At the [[2002 Bespin Regionals]], Coach's Corner, Apache Plaza Mall, St. Anthony, Minnesota, 15 June 2002.

== Source and credit ==

Published on the MNSWCCG website's "2002 Bespin Regional Weekend Pictures" page: [http://www.mnswccg.com/bespin_regional/2002_Bespin_Regional_Pictures.html mnswccg.com/bespin_regional/2002_Bespin_Regional_Pictures.html]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021102035753/http://www.mnswccg.com/bespin_regional/2002_Bespin_Regional_Pictures.html Internet Archive]. The page does not say who took the pictures; [[Nick Kolnik]], who ran the site, directed the event.

* '''Source caption:''' "2002 Bespin Regional Champion"
* '''Original image:''' http://www.mnswccg.com/bespin_regional/2002_weekend_pictures/IM000684.JPG. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021118133850/http://www.mnswccg.com:80/bespin_regional/2002_weekend_pictures/IM000684.JPG Internet Archive]
* '''Date photographed:''' 15 June 2002
